Open a private presentation

Download presentation.enc from Google Drive, then select it here. Your browser decrypts the file on this device; nothing is uploaded.

Choose Files / Downloads in Android’s file picker. Maximum package size: 32 MiB.

Anyone with the key and package can read the presentation. Keep the access link private and separate from the uploaded package.

Select a package and supply its key.

Playback starts only when you press Play. This viewer does not save keys, presentation content, or progress to browser storage. Closing or reloading requires unlocking again. Downloads, browser history, and clipboard copies remain under your control.

Android Chrome is the initial target. Screen-off/background playback and low-memory devices are not guaranteed. Use only approved storage for work material.
